name: frustrated customer requests manager
description: Customer expresses frustration and anger, demanding to speak to a manager, which should trigger handover to a human agent

messages.text: This is taking too long, let me speak to your manager. I've been waiting for ages and nobody is helping me.

expected_behaviors.description: AI should trigger handover to human agent

notes: Frustrated or angry customers requesting escalation should be handed over immediately to de-escalate and provide personalised service.
